def load() -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    path = 'data/environment/input/constitution_beach_datasheet.csv'

    # The file contains 2 header rows (site title row + subheader with North/Middle/South)
    # followed by the real header row.
    df = pd.read_csv(path, header=2)
    return df

def process(constitutionBeach) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd

    df = constitutionBeach.copy()

    # Parse date and filter to 2024
    df['dateParsed'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Date'], errors='coerce')
    df = df[df['dateParsed'].dt.year == 2024].copy()

    # Determine if each sampling point meets the standard (< 104 counts/100 mL)
    cols = ['Enterococcus', 'Enterococcus.1', 'Enterococcus.2']
    meet = df[cols].lt(104)

    # Consider only rows where at least one point is measured (non-null)
    nonNullAny = df[cols].notna().any(axis=1)
    meet = meet[nonNullAny]

    # A day is mixed if at least one point meets and at least one does not (among non-null points)
    anyMeet = meet.any(axis=1)
    anyNotMeet = (df.loc[meet.index, cols].ge(104) & df.loc[meet.index, cols].notna()).any(axis=1)
    mixed = anyMeet & anyNotMeet

    out = pd.DataFrame({'mixedDaysCount': [int(mixed.sum())]})
    return out

operators.customDisplayName: Count Constitution Beach sampling days in year 2024 where sampling points have mixed compliance with Enterococcus standard (<104 counts/100 mL): parse 'Date' to datetime, filter year==2024; evaluate ['Enterococcus','Enterococcus.1','Enterococcus.2'] per row; mark mixed when at least one non-null value <104 and at least one non-null value >=104; return single-row DataFrame with mixedDaysCount
